subject: A single architectural grid-frame model: a small lattice skeleton of thin pale timber members forming square cells (like the frame of a hanok courtyard house or a display shelf grid), standing alone on a low dark plinth in a museum.
purpose: Photo set inside the word 'Contain' on a black magazine page; it must read as one object at small size.
style: Editorial museum photography, real photograph, sharp, medium-format look, no illustration.
composition: Frontal, the model fills most of the frame vertically, tight decisive crop, centered, generous black around top and sides only slightly.
palette: Near-black background, warm pale wood, a small accent of muted red allowed in one cell.
lighting: Single soft museum spotlight from above, deep shadows, no glare.
notes: High resolution detail on the joints; background must fall to black so it sits on a (4,5,5) black page.
